text: Other worlds stranger things release date: 2028 on Netflix. Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure is expected to premiere on Netflix in 2028. Netflix announced it on Nov. 6, 2026, as a live-action prequel series set in the 1950s, before the original Stranger Things and before the stage play The First Shadow. No exact month or day has been announced.. Netflix officially ordered Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure to series on Nov. 6, 2026, giving the spinoff a 2028 target. Casting has not yet been announced.. The series is set on April 19, 1955, in Marion, Nevada, according to a teaser Netflix released with the announcement. The teaser shows a deserted bike beside a restricted area at night. Kate Trefry, who wrote the stage play The First Shadow, is co-creator and showrunner. Joe Wright, the British director, will direct the first three episodes. The Duffer brothers, Matt and Ross, are co-creators and executive producers. Filming will take place in New Mexico. The announcement came on Stranger Things Day, Nov. 6, the date Will Byers disappeared in the original 1983 story. Other Worlds is the fourth project in the franchise, after the original series, the animated Tales from '85, and The First Shadow. The original show ended its run with a final season in 2025.

What is the Hank Aaron Award? MLB's top hitter honor, 2026 winners Nov. 11. The Hank Aaron Award honors the most outstanding offensive player of the regular season in each league. MLB created it in 1999, the 25th anniversary of Aaron breaking Babe Ruth's home run record. Winners are picked by a fan vote plus a panel of baseball legends; the 2026 winners are announced Wednesday, Nov. 11, at 9 p.m. ET on MLB Network.. MLB announces the 2026 Hank Aaron Award winners on Nov. 11, 2026, at its awards show in Las Vegas.. A committee of MLB.com journalists picked 10 finalists per league from the season's top offensive numbers. Fan voting at MLB.com/aaron ran from Oct. 5 to Oct. 12, 2026. The panel of legends and past winners includes Derek Jeter, David Ortiz, Albert Pujols, Ken Griffey Jr., Chipper Jones, Pedro Martínez, John Smoltz, Johnny Bench, Craig Biggio and Eddie Murray. Shohei Ohtani, a 2026 finalist, won the award three years in a row (2023-2025). Other finalists named by MLB include Jordan Walker and Bobby Witt Jr. The winners are revealed at the MLB Awards at The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas, the same show that unveils the All-MLB Team.

How is the Cy Young Award voted? 30 writers, 5 spots, 7-4-3-2-1 points. The Cy Young Award is voted on by 30 members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America in each league, two from each MLB city. Each ranks five pitchers, scored 7, 4, 3, 2 and 1 points, and the highest total wins. Ballots are submitted before the postseason. The 2026 winners are announced Wednesday, Nov. 11, at 7 p.m. ET on MLB Network.. The 2026 Cy Young Award winners will be announced on Nov. 11, 2026, on MLB Network.. Writers in National League cities vote for the NL award and writers in American League cities for the AL award. Voters are recommended by their local BBWAA chapter chairman and approved by the national secretary-treasurer. A writer may not split a ballot spot between two pitchers. Because ballots are due before the playoffs, postseason games do not count. The BBWAA has posted full voting results online since 2012. The 2026 finalists are Dylan Cease (Blue Jays), Parker Messick (Guardians) and Cam Schlittler (Yankees) in the American League, and Jacob Misiorowski (Brewers), Chris Sale (Braves) and Cristopher Sánchez (Phillies) in the National League. The same show also names the first BBWAA Relief Pitcher of the Year in each league, a new award in 2026.

Why is Maine's 2nd District going to ranked choice? No one passed 50%. Because neither Republican Paul LePage nor Democrat Matt Dunlap won more than 50% of the votes, and Maine law then requires a ranked-choice tabulation. More than 6,000 ballots were blank in the race and 123 votes went to write-ins. The count starts Monday, Nov. 9, 2026, at 10 a.m. In Augusta and usually takes about a week.. Maine's Secretary of State will run a ranked-choice tabulation in the 2nd Congressional District starting Nov. 9, 2026, after no candidate topped 50%.. Initial results reported to the Secretary of State showed LePage with 170,263 votes (49.9%) and Dunlap with 164,845 (48.3%), a gap of 5,418 votes out of just over 341,000 ballots. LePage, a former Republican governor of Maine, declared victory on Wednesday, Nov. 4. Dunlap conceded on Thursday, Nov. 5, saying, "This isn't the result we were hoping for." The tabulation still goes ahead, because it is a required step in certifying the result. The count is held at the Maine Department of Public Safety headquarters in Augusta, is open to the public and is streamed on the Secretary of State's YouTube channel. Secretary of State Shenna Bellows said it usually takes about a week. In past runoffs most blank ballots dropped out after the first round, which Maine Public says would give LePage a majority of the remaining ballots. Maine has used ranked-choice voting since 2018 for state and federal primaries and for federal general elections. This is the fourth time in nine years the 2nd District has needed a ranked-choice runoff; retiring Democratic Rep. Jared Golden won the three earlier ones. In the U.S. Senate race, Democrat Troy Jackson won a majority of first choices over Susan Collins, so no ranked-choice count was needed there.

How is MLB Manager of the Year voted? 30 writers, 3 spots, 5-3-1. MLB's Manager of the Year is voted on by 30 members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America in each league, two from each city. Each ranks three managers, worth 5, 3 and 1 points, before the postseason begins. The BBWAA created the award in 1983. The 2026 winners are announced Tuesday, Nov. 10.. The BBWAA announces the 2026 Manager of the Year winners on Nov. 10, 2026.. Because ballots are due before the playoffs, a manager's postseason run does not count. Writers in American League cities vote on the AL award and writers in National League cities on the NL award. A voter may not split a spot between two managers, and full ballots have been published online since 2012. The 2026 finalists are Kevin Cash (Rays), Chad Tracy (Red Sox) and Will Venable (White Sox) in the American League, and Don Mattingly (Phillies), Pat Murphy (Brewers) and Walt Weiss (Braves) in the National League. Manager of the Year was the BBWAA's newest award until 2026, when the writers added Relief Pitcher of the Year.

What makes a player a rookie in MLB? 130 at-bats, 50 innings, 45 days. In MLB a player is still a rookie unless, in previous seasons, he went over 130 at-bats or 50 innings pitched in the majors, or 45 days on an active big-league roster during the regular season, not counting time on the injured list. Only rookies can win Rookie of the Year; the 2026 winners are announced Monday, Nov. 9.. The 2026 Rookie of the Year Awards open MLB's awards week on Nov. 9, 2026.. The limits count only earlier seasons, so a player can pass them during his rookie year and still win the award that year. Days on the injured list do not count toward the 45 days. The same rule decides who can appear on MLB Pipeline prospect lists. The award, officially the Jackie Robinson Rookie of the Year, is voted on by 30 baseball writers per league. Each ranks three players, scored 5, 3 and 1 points. The 2026 finalists are Kevin McGonigle (Tigers), Parker Messick (Guardians) and Payton Tolle (Red Sox) in the American League, and Carson Benge (Mets), Sal Stewart (Reds) and JJ Wetherholt (Cardinals) in the National League. Messick is also a finalist for the AL Cy Young.

What is the All-MLB Team? Fans and a panel pick it; 2026 team revealed Nov. 11. The All-MLB Team is MLB's season-end honor for the best players at each position, regardless of league. Since 2019 it has a First and Second Team, each with 9 hitters and 7 pitchers, chosen half by fan vote and half by a panel. The 2026 teams are announced Wednesday, Nov. 11, at the MLB Awards in Las Vegas on MLB Network.. The 2026 All-MLB First and Second Teams will be revealed on Nov. 11, 2026, at the MLB Awards show in Las Vegas.. Each team has a catcher, first, second and third baseman, shortstop, three outfielders (with no left/center/right split), a designated hitter, five starting pitchers and two relievers. Fans and a panel of media members, broadcasters, former players and officials have equal say in the picks. Fan voting for 2026 ran from Sept. 28 to Oct. 9, 2026, at mlb.com/allmlb; the nominee list included 91 All-Stars, 15 rookies and 44 previous All-MLB honorees. The teams are revealed at the fourth annual MLB Awards, held at The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas and shown on MLB Network at 9 p.m. ET. The same show presents the Hank Aaron Awards, Comeback Player of the Year, the Rivera and Hoffman Reliever of the Year Awards, the Edgar Martinez Outstanding Designated Hitter Award and Executive of the Year.

Is Murder in Galicia a true story? Yes: the 2015 Pazos case in Spain. Yes. Netflix's Murder in Galicia (El crimen de Pazos), out Nov. 13, 2026, is a fictionalized drama based on a real case: Isabel Fuentes, 66, was attacked with a hammer at her home in Pazos, Verín, in April 2015 and stabbed to death in her Ourense hospital room on May 8, 2015. Her husband, Aniceto Rodríguez, was convicted.. Netflix released the documentary Unprotected: Murder in Galicia on Nov. 6, 2026, and the drama Murder in Galicia follows on Nov. 13.. In 2017 the Ourense Provincial Court found Aniceto Rodríguez guilty of attempted murder and murder and sentenced him to 31 years in total (12 for the hammer attack, 19 for the killing). Spain's Supreme Court upheld the sentence in December 2017. Rodríguez died in A Lama prison in 2018 without finishing it. He had staged the first attack to look like a burglary. The series is a short Spanish miniseries from Bambú Producciones, directed by Carlos Sedes and written by Ramón Campos, David Orea, Curro Serrano and Gema R. Neira. Tristán Ulloa plays Elías, a Guardia Civil sergeant, and Miguel Borines plays Aniceto; the victim is renamed Irene. Netflix also released a documentary on the same case a week earlier: Unprotected: Murder in Galicia, directed by Jorge Laplace, premiered on Nov. 6, 2026. Laplace says its central question is how she could be murdered in a hospital when it was known she was in danger.

What is the Relief Pitcher of the Year award? New MLB honor, first winners Nov. 11. The Relief Pitcher of the Year is a new award from the Baseball Writers' Association of America for the best reliever in each league. 2026 is its first season. Winners are announced on MLB Network on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, in the 7-8 p.m. ET show together with the Cy Young Awards.. The first BBWAA Relief Pitcher of the Year winners will be announced on Nov. 11, 2026.. The BBWAA announced on Aug. 23, 2025, that it had voted to create the award in each league. It is the writers' fifth annual award after MVP, Cy Young, Rookie of the Year and Manager of the Year, and their first new one since Manager of the Year in 1983. Jayson Stark, who chaired the committee that proposed it, said "relief pitching now dominates this sport." The 2026 finalists are Bryan Baker (Rays), Cade Smith (Guardians) and Louis Varland (Blue Jays) in the American League, and Jhoan Duran (Phillies), Trevor Megill (Brewers) and Mason Miller (Padres) in the National League. It is not the same as the Mariano Rivera and Trevor Hoffman Reliever of the Year Awards, which MLB has given since 2014 and which are voted on by retired relievers; those are presented later the same night at the MLB Awards show. Earlier reliever honors included the formula-based Rolaids Relief Man Award and MLB's Delivery Man of the Year (2005-2013).

Is Reminders of Him based on a book? Yes, Colleen Hoover's 2022 novel. Yes. Reminders of Him is based on Colleen Hoover's novel of the same name, published on Jan. 18, 2022. The Universal Pictures film opened in theaters on March 13, 2026, streamed on Peacock from July 10, 2026, and arrives on Netflix in the U.S. On Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026.. The Colleen Hoover adaptation Reminders of Him starts streaming on Netflix in the U.S. On Nov. 10, 2026.. The book follows Kenna, who learns she is pregnant only after she is imprisoned for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty. Her daughter, Diem, is born while she is in prison, and Scotty's parents get custody. After her release Kenna wants to know her daughter, who is now 5, but Scotty's parents refuse to hear her side and have a restraining order against her. Ledger, Scotty's best friend, helps raise Diem and blames Kenna, yet finds himself drawn to her. The movie was directed by Vanessa Caswill (Love at First Sight) from a screenplay by Colleen Hoover and Lauren Levine. Maika Monroe plays Kenna Rowan and Tyriq Withers plays Ledger Ward; Rudy Pankow, Lauren Graham, Bradley Whitford and country singer Lainey Wilson also appear. The film comes to Netflix through Universal's deal that sends its live-action movies to Netflix after their first streaming window. The Nov. 10 date applies to the U.S.; the film was already on Netflix in some countries, including Australia and New Zealand. What's on Netflix expects it to leave Netflix around September 2027 and return to Peacock.

What does habibi mean? 'My love' in Arabic, as Love Is Blind: Habibi returns. Habibi is an Arabic term of endearment that literally means "my love" (also "my dear" or "darling"). Habib means a loved one and the ending -i means "my". It is said to partners, children and friends; the feminine form is habibti. Netflix's Love Is Blind: Habibi season 2 starts Nov. 12, 2026.. Season 2 of Netflix's Love Is Blind: Habibi premieres on Nov. 12, 2026, putting the word habibi in front of American viewers again.. The meaning depends on who is talking. From a parent to a child it works like "sweetie" or "honey"; between partners it means "my love"; between friends it is closer to "my friend" or "bro". In some places, including Lebanon, people even use it with strangers to soften a conversation. In songs it is sung to both men and women. Love Is Blind: Habibi is the Arabic version of Netflix's dating show. Season 2 premieres globally on Nov. 12, 2026, with 10 episodes, 27 singles (13 men and 14 women) from across the Arab world, and new hosts Wissam Breidy and Rym Saidi. Season 1 was hosted by Khaled Saqer and Elham Ali and filmed in the UAE and Lebanon.
